title: Service package identity (package.json) — contract v1
description: The service-level half of a package, at packages/<category>/<service>/package.json. It holds what is true of the service across every version — its name, its category, its icon — so that a version manifest does not repeat it once per version and cannot disagree with itself across five copies. Everything version-specific is in package-version.schema.json.

service.description: Service id. Must equal the containing directory name, and must be unique across the whole registry — it is the first half of every instance slug.

category.description: Must equal the containing <category> directory name. The eight are env.schema.json's existing groups, kept rather than reinvented so the migration has nothing to translate — the only change is adminUis becoming admin-uis, because a directory name should not be camelCase.

name.description: Locale → display name. 'en' is required as the fallback for locales the package does not carry.

recommendedVersion.description: Which of this service's versions the picker selects by default, and — ADR 0014 — what `latest` resolves to. Lives here rather than on each version because it is a statement about the service: putting it on the versions would let two of them claim it, and nothing would say which was right. build-registry.mjs copies it onto the matching version entry as `recommended`.

summary.description: Locale → one line, shown on the market card. Not a description of the software — a sentence about why you would install it here.

icon.description: Beside package.json. Hashed like every other file: an icon is content that reaches a renderer, and content that reaches a renderer from the network is content that gets verified.

homepage.description: Where the packaged software documents itself. Shown on the market card; never fetched by the app.

maintainer.description: Who is answerable for this package. 'stackvo' for the official set; third-party sources are a v2 question (ADR 0013 keeps the source pluggable, docs §4.6 keeps the door shut for now).

license.description: SPDX id of the packaged SOFTWARE, not of the manifest. Feeds the NOTICE generation the repo already does.

keywords.description: Search terms. 'mysql' should be findable by typing 'database' and by typing 'mariadb'.

legacyEnvPrefix.description: The SERVICE_<ID>_ prefix this service used before packages existed, for migration only. Present because the mapping is not always mechanical: mongo-express uppercases to MONGO_EXPRESS, and a reader that derives it instead of reading it will one day derive it differently in two places — which is exactly how C-09 happened (profile `mongo_express` vs compose profile `mongo-express`).
